name: Maryam Al-Kuwari
background: Maryam owns a growing distribution business in Doha, Qatar, that supplies packaging to cafes and retailers.
public_financial_situation: The business has regular customer receipts and supplier payments. Maryam wants to explore banking services that support day-to-day operations and growth.
interview_opening_context: Maryam has booked a meeting to review the business's banking arrangements as she considers taking on larger retail orders.
